author: okiikoumon
quote: This is not a GTA game. Forgetting about the horrible story writing for a second, nothing else feels like gta spirit at all. They purposely handicap you, restrict you, and push you to play this game the way they want you to. Want to wear those clothes? Nope we’ll change them on you over and over again. Want to steal that car? Not in this neighborhood. Want to shoot up a place? Better not be a nightclub or protesters. Want to crash a plane? Nope. Want to create havoc in a creative way? Nope. Saving the worst for last. 30FPS. 30FPS. one more time. In 2026. 30 FPS. I couldn’t hate this game any more.
